rca_of_issue: Fixes verified: (1) getDeviceId() in src/lib/device.ts now uses a shared `pending` Promise so concurrent first callers get the same id — resolved the multi-device_id race. (2) player-drag-zone (app/player.tsx) has an overlay so the underlying no longer swallows the pan gesture on web; onEnd fires and router.back() dismisses the panel. (3) audio-context queue handling: tapping a Search track no longer queues the full search list — it queues only that song and autofills Up Next with related tracks (observed 10 related songs, none from the 8-item Hosanna search list). (4) Search endpoint: artist-name matches no longer hijack song-title queries; 'hosanna' cleanly returns song rows with no top-result artist card, while 'arijit singh' still returns a top card + artistSongs. All 3 backend assertions and all 6 frontend acceptance items pass.
